args.message: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN for banker's rounding per FIN-212

args.head: fix/banker-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` uses `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change
- `src/money.py`: switch from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so `2.665` rounds to `2.66` (even digit) and `2.675` rounds to `2.68`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on branch `fix/banker-rounding`.

authority: Merging into main requires approval from a code owner

- round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68") — with ROUND_HALF_EVEN, 2.675 quantized to 0.01: the digit after is 5, and the last retained digit is 7 (odd), so round up to 2.68. ✓
